verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents some built-in event-driven automation. Conditional access policies revoke access instantly when a device falls out of compliance or leaves a trusted network, and the platform runs automatic onboarding/offboarding workflows driven by HRIS and identity-lifecycle changes. There is no evidence of a general rule engine where users define arbitrary event→action rules, and API/PowerShell bulk operations are developer building blocks, not rules. missing for 10: user-definable event-trigger rule builder, configurable actions beyond access revocation and lifecycle provisioning, detailed docs on trigger/condition configuration, independent corroboration.
